# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of RLX Patches gets security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a vulnerability. Report it privately with
**Security → Report a vulnerability** on this repository
(https://github.com/Ramik4/rlx-patches/security/advisories/new).

Include the RLX Patches version, the app and its version, and the steps to reproduce.
You will get an answer within a few days.

Vulnerabilities of the patches RLX takes from Morphe Patches unchanged also concern Morphe;
they are fixed there and come to RLX with the next sync. See
https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches.
